name: Shard of a temple bell
description: A curved piece of bronze, green with age. When struck, it still rings with a sound that makes dogs howl.
findText: In the grounds of a ruined mountain temple, you find a curved shard of ancient bronze. When your fingers touch it, you hear a bell toll that nobody else can hear.

name: Rusted sword hilt
description: The hilt of a sword whose blade was lost long ago, wrapped in leather that should have rotted centuries ago.
findText: At the bottom of a box of junk at an estate sale, you find the hilt of a sword with no blade. Its grip is warm, as if someone has only just let go of it.

name: Alchemist's cracked vial
description: A small glass vial with a hairline crack. A drop of silver liquid inside never evaporates.
findText: Behind a loose brick in an old cellar, you find a cracked glass vial. A single drop of quicksilver inside moves to follow your finger.

name: Gambler's ivory die
description: A yellowed ivory die. Whenever someone holding it is in danger, it lands on six.
findText: A card dealer on a riverboat loses a bet to you and pays with an ivory die. You roll it a hundred times that night. It never lands on anything but six.

name: Black stone arrowhead
description: A finely worked arrowhead of black volcanic glass, still sharp enough to draw blood.
findText: In a dusty museum storeroom, a tired curator lets you take a box marked for disposal. Inside, wrapped in newspaper, is an arrowhead of black glass that cuts your thumb the moment you touch it.
